notes: The marginal note on the name (In 21:17, Jehoahaz) was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.

s019 could instead have been read with *of men* as a rectum under rule 19, but no second source nominal stands in the phrase, so rule 31's supplied-generic reading governs and the head stays on *band*.
s009 is the agreement article on הַקָּטֹן: the phrase's one determiner is the possessive *his*, which the suffix licenses, so the article is unrepresented under rule 41's limit.
